description: At Fieldora, we believe great ideas can come from any age. Built by a 13-year-old and a 10-year-old, our team is driven by curiosity, creativity, and a genuine interest in using technology to solve real-world challenges. We approach every project with a willingness to learn, experiment, and turn ideas into something meaningful. Our goal is to build thoughtful and reliable applications that reflect the effort we put into understanding each challenge and finding ways to make a difference.
summary:
Imagine being a farmer, making decisions every day that could determine the success or failure of an entire harvest, without having all the information you need.

That's the challenge Fieldora was developed to address.

Fieldora is an intelligent farmland monitoring platform that brings soil moisture monitoring, crop NDVI analysis, weather forecasts, and rainfall trends together in one centralized dashboard.

Instead of switching between different sources and trying to make sense of scattered information, farmers can access important insights about their fields in one simple, easy-to-use platform, helping them make faster and more informed agricultural decisions.

Fieldora is more than just monitoring farmland, it's about making agricultural technology accessible, simplifying field management, and giving farmers the information they need to make better decisions.

Because farming shouldn't have to rely on guesswork when better information can make all the difference.
details:
Imagine having to manage an entire farm while constantly switching between different platforms just to understand what's happening in your fields.

We wanted to change that.

Fieldora is a farmland monitoring platform designed to bring essential agricultural information together in one place. It allows farmers to monitor soil moisture, analyze crop health through NDVI, view weather forecasts, and track rainfall trends through a simple, centralized dashboard. Farmers can easily set up their fields and access relevant information without having to search across multiple websites.

We developed Fieldora using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Cloudflare Workers, and environmental data, building a platform focused on speed, simplicity, and accessibility.

What makes Fieldora creative is also where our team's background comes in. Coming from a country where agriculture plays an important role in communities and livelihoods, we have a familiarity with the challenges and realities surrounding farming. That perspective helped inspire us to take something we understand and explore how technology could make it easier for farmers to access the information they need.

Throughout development, we considered the needs of farmers, ease of setup, performance, clarity of information, and the importance of presenting useful data without unnecessary complexity.

Our goal is simple: make farming smarter, field monitoring easier, and better agricultural decisions more accessible. We want to help farmers spend less time searching for information and more time making decisions that matter.
